      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTimeCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeCheck" name="Less than 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotQualified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToTimeCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Qualified</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotQualified</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrainAndCheck" name="Train and check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotQualified</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Qualified</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCalculateTimeLeft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateTimeLeft" name="Calculate time between starting time and end of workday">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCalculateTimeLeft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToWorkdayCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WorkdayCheck" name="More than one hour left?" default="Flow_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToWorkdayCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go there from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromHomeToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromWorkToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TravelMerge" name="Merge travel option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromHomeToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromWorkToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRunDrinkSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" name="Start running and drinking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRunDrinkSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRunNightRun</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run at Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRunNightRun</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin" name="Running and drinking finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToReceiveTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToReceiveTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalTime" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSelectBlock" sourceRef="Start_Participate" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToRunMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Gateway_RunMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunMergeToRun" sourceRef="Gateway_RunMerge" targetRef="Task_RunAndMeasure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTimeCheck" sourceRef="Task_RunAndMeasure" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Qualified" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${runningTimeMinutes < 25}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotQualified" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_TrainAndCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainLoop" sourceRef="Task_TrainAndCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RunMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCalculateTimeLeft" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CalculateTimeLeft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToWorkdayCheck" sourceRef="Task_CalculateTimeLeft" targetRef="Gateway_WorkdayCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHome" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkdayCheck" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${minutesBetweenStartAndWorkdayEnd > 60}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkdayCheck" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromHomeToMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_TravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromWorkToMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_TravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRunDrinkSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRunNightRun" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToJoin" sourceRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReceiveTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="End_FinalTime"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
